description: OpenTabs plugin for Google Cloud Console

tools.name: get_current_project
tools.description: Get the currently active GCP project from the console URL. Returns the project ID the user is currently viewing.

tools.name: list_projects
tools.description: List all GCP projects accessible to the current user. Returns project IDs, names, and lifecycle states.

tools.name: get_project
tools.description: Get detailed information about a GCP project by its project ID. Defaults to the currently active project if no ID is provided.

tools.name: list_instances
tools.description: List Compute Engine VM instances in a zone. If no zone is specified, lists instances across all zones using aggregated list.

tools.name: get_instance
tools.description: Get detailed information about a specific Compute Engine VM instance.

tools.name: start_instance
tools.description: Start a stopped Compute Engine VM instance. The instance must be in TERMINATED or STOPPED state.

tools.name: stop_instance
tools.description: Stop a running Compute Engine VM instance. The instance must be in RUNNING state.

tools.name: list_disks
tools.description: List Compute Engine persistent disks. If no zone is specified, lists across all zones.

tools.name: list_networks
tools.description: List VPC networks in the project.

tools.name: list_firewalls
tools.description: List firewall rules in the project.

tools.name: list_buckets
tools.description: List Cloud Storage buckets in the project.

tools.name: get_bucket
tools.description: Get detailed information about a specific Cloud Storage bucket.

tools.name: list_objects
tools.description: List objects in a Cloud Storage bucket. Supports prefix filtering for directory-like browsing.

tools.name: list_service_accounts
tools.description: List IAM service accounts in the project.

tools.name: list_iam_roles
tools.description: List custom IAM roles defined in the project. Use "roles" as a prefix to list predefined roles.

tools.name: get_iam_policy
tools.description: Get the IAM access control policy for the project. Returns all role bindings (who has which role).

tools.name: list_enabled_services
tools.description: List GCP API services enabled in the project. Each service represents an API that has been activated.

tools.name: enable_service
tools.description: Enable a GCP API service in the project. The service name is the API identifier (e.g., "compute.googleapis.com").

tools.name: disable_service
tools.description: Disable a GCP API service in the project. WARNING: This may break resources that depend on this service.

tools.name: list_functions
tools.description: List Cloud Functions in the project across all locations.

tools.name: get_function
tools.description: Get detailed information about a specific Cloud Function.

tools.name: list_cloud_run_services
tools.description: List Cloud Run services in the project across all locations.

tools.name: get_cloud_run_service
tools.description: Get detailed information about a specific Cloud Run service.

tools.name: list_log_entries
tools.description: List log entries from Cloud Logging. Supports advanced log filters (e.g., 'severity>=ERROR', 'resource.type="gce_instance"').

tools.name: list_billing_accounts
tools.description: List billing accounts accessible to the current user.

tools.name: get_billing_info
tools.description: Get billing information for a project, including whether billing is enabled and which billing account is linked.

tools.name: list_clusters
tools.description: List Google Kubernetes Engine (GKE) clusters in the project across all locations.

tools.name: get_cluster
tools.description: Get detailed information about a specific GKE cluster.

tools.name: list_sql_instances
tools.description: List Cloud SQL database instances in the project.

tools.name: get_sql_instance
tools.description: Get detailed information about a specific Cloud SQL database instance.
